page.title: Academic leadership & scientific service
page.intro: Building international research connections, supporting scientific quality and recognising contributions to geospatial and environmental research.

sections.title: Scientific networks & community building
sections.intro: Connecting research groups, infrastructures and international scientific communities.

items.title: International Long-Term Experiment Networks
items.text:
- Scientific coordination of ZALF’s long-term experiment network and international cooperation.
- Connecting European and global LTE communities through knowledge exchange and metadata harmonisation.
- Supporting research infrastructure development and reuse of long-term experimental evidence.

items.title: LANDGIS Research Laboratory
items.text:
- Co-leadership of the LANDGIS Research Laboratory at Çukurova University.
- Mentoring a multidisciplinary team of 13 researchers.
- Collaborative research across GIS, remote sensing, environmental modelling and landscape planning.

items.title: Scientific Awards & Recognition
items.text:
- Best Publication Award — Japanese Society of Irrigation, Drainage and Rural Engineering (2020).
- ESRI Award — Citrus Information System application (2012).
- Scientific-performance recognition — Turkish Research Council (2023 and 2024).
- Publication-performance recognition — ZALF (research published during 2021–2024).
